journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
title: Preparation and Hydrogen Storage Properties of Zeolite-Templated Carbon Materials Nanocast via Chemical Vapor Deposition: Effect of the Zeolite Template and Nitrogen Doping
material_description: CX750 | nitrogen-doped zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of acetonitrile in zeolite 13X at 750 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
source_location: main p.4 Table 1 (hydrogen uptake, −196 °C, 20 bar) and main p.7 text (volumetric density); Figure 8 curve c (main p.7)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. Volumetric density 26 g/L printed in text (p.7), derived by the authors from the 20 bar gravimetric uptake with an assumed packing density of 1.0 g/cm3 (ref. 46), not measured. digitized: 19.929 bar, 2.601 wt%, archive: fig8_red.json. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig8_red.json. Figure 8: buoyancy correction with sample density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig1S_red.json. Figure 1S: same samples as Figure 8 plotted without buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 (sample density 1.5 g/cm3 still used); given its own isotherm_id. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction for the sample only: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; no correction for adsorbed H2

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
functional_groups: pyridine-like N (398.6 eV) and quaternary N (400.5 eV) by XPS N1s
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig8_red.json. Figure 8: buoyancy correction with sample density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

material_description: CX800 | nitrogen-doped zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of acetonitrile in zeolite 13X at 800 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
functional_groups: pyridine-like N (398.6 eV) and quaternary N (400.5 eV) by XPS N1s
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig1S_red.json. Figure 1S: same samples as Figure 8 plotted without buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 (sample density 1.5 g/cm3 still used); given its own isotherm_id. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction for the sample only: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; no correction for adsorbed H2

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig8_red.json. Figure 8: buoyancy correction with sample density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

material_description: CX850 | nitrogen-doped zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of acetonitrile in zeolite 13X at 850 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig1S_red.json. Figure 1S: same samples as Figure 8 plotted without buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 (sample density 1.5 g/cm3 still used); given its own isotherm_id. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 0 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction for the sample only: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; no correction for adsorbed H2

material_description: CYE550 | zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of ethylene in zeolite Y at 550 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig8_blue.json. Figure 8: buoyancy correction with sample density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 1 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

material_description: CYE550 | zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of ethylene in zeolite Y at 550 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig1S_blue.json. Figure 1S: same samples as Figure 8 plotted without buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 (sample density 1.5 g/cm3 still used); given its own isotherm_id. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 1 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Gravimetric, Hiden IGA-003; degassed at 200 °C overnight to 10^-10 bar (printed; stored as 1e-05 Pa); duration "overnight" not numeric. archive: fig8_blue.json. Figure 8: buoyancy correction with sample density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: 35 markers resolvable at >=2.5 bar including the 20 bar end point, plus 1 resolved below 2.4 bar; other low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. Basis not named by the paper; basis_inferred excess by the gravimetric default (buoyancy correction stated).
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; temperature not stated

material_description: CX850 | nitrogen-doped zeolite-templated carbon nanocast by CVD of acetonitrile in zeolite 13X at 850 °C (3 h, N2 flow); template removed with 10% HF and refluxing conc. HCl at 60 °C; dried at 120 °C
purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Volumetric, Micromeritics ASAP 2020; evacuated at 200 °C under vacuum overnight; free-volume determination not described. Basis not named; basis_inferred excess by the volumetric default. archive: fig10A_black.json. Curve assignment made by position (both curves black). isotherm_point_count includes markers merged with neighbours and one triangle at (0, ~0.02 wt%) of uncertain curve. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption.
